text: {"reply":"Hi {first_name}, thank you for writing, and I'm glad you're feeling better. Please keep taking your fluoxetine just as it is for now. Your clinician will advise you about any change to your dose or about stopping, so please don't change it on your own. If you'd like to talk it over, you can book a visit or call the clinic. If you start to feel worse or have new symptoms, please book a visit or call the clinic."}
